Big Tech earnings recap 🧵

1/ Amazon's revenue hit $143.1 billion in calendar Q3 2023. Retail is back.

2/ NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 revenue was $60.9 billion, more than double the year before.

3/ Apple pulled in $416.2 billion of revenue in fiscal Q4 2025 alone. Insane quarter.

4/ My take: NVDA at 30x sales is still cheap.
